# aws

AWS helpers: caller identity, EC2/region inspection, SSM Parameter Store CRUD, IAM bootstrap, and Session Manager shells.

---

## `aws_ec2_diff_launch_template_versions`

Diff two versions of an EC2 launch template. Version indexes are offsets into the API response, newest first: 0 is latest, 1 the one before it.

**Usage**

```sh
aws_ec2_diff_launch_template_versions <launch-template-id> [older-index] [newer-index]
```

**Examples**

```sh
aws_ec2_diff_launch_template_versions lt-0123456789abcdef0 1 0
```

**Requires** `aws`, `jq`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/aws.sh:145`](../../modules/common/aws.sh#L145)

## `aws_ec2_find_ami`

Search for EC2 AMIs through Ansible's ec2_ami_find module. Extra ansible flags come from ANSIBLE_LOCAL_FLAGS.

**Usage**

```sh

```

**Examples**

```sh

```

## `aws_iam_create_bucket_writer`

Create an IAM user plus a bucket-scoped PutObject policy, giving you a chance to edit the policy in $EDITOR before it is created. The policy document lives in a private temp file that is removed on return.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Creates real IAM principals. The attach step is printed, not run.

**Usage**

```sh
aws_iam_create_bucket_writer <username> <bucket> <policy-name>
```

**Examples**

```sh
aws_iam_create_bucket_writer uploads-ci my-uploads uploads-put
```

**Requires** `aws`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/aws.sh:557`](../../modules/common/aws.sh#L557)

**See also** `aws_iam_attach_policy`

## `aws_ssm_copy_param`

Copy one decrypted SecureString from a source account to a destination account. The value is passed in memory from the read to the write; it never touches the clipboard or disk.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Moves a decrypted secret between AWS accounts and overwrites the destination parameter. Profiles default to $SOURCE_PROFILE and $DEST_PROFILE. Double-check both before confirming.

**Usage**

```sh
aws_ssm_copy_param <source-path> <dest-path> [source-profile] [dest-profile]
```

**Examples**

```sh
aws_ssm_copy_param /production/billing/env /staging/billing/env prod-ro staging-rw
```

**Requires** `aws`, `jq`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/aws.sh:338`](../../modules/common/aws.sh#L338)

**See also** `aws_ssm_get_param_by_path`, `aws_ssm_put_param_by_path`

---

## `aws_ssm_edit_param`

Fetch a parameter into a private temp file, open it in $EDITOR, then write the edited content back. The plaintext file is created with mode 600 and removed on return, on error, and on interrupt.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Materialises a decrypted SecureString on local disk for the duration of the edit, and overwrites the stored parameter on save.

**Usage**

```sh
aws_ssm_edit_param <app> [environment] [suffix]
```

**Examples**

```sh
aws_ssm_edit_param billing production env
```

**Requires** `aws`, `jq`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/aws.sh:264`](../../modules/common/aws.sh#L264)

---

## `aws_ssm_put_env_file`

Read a KEY=VALUE file and write each line to SSM as a SecureString under a shared prefix. Blank lines and # comments are skipped.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Writes every line of the file into Parameter Store.

**Usage**

```sh
aws_ssm_put_env_file <env-file> [prefix]
```

**Examples**

```sh
aws_ssm_put_env_file .env.production /production/billing/
```

**Requires** `aws`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/aws.sh:380`](../../modules/common/aws.sh#L380)

---

## `aws_ssm_put_param`

Write a SecureString parameter to /<env>/<app>/<suffix>, overwriting any existing value.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Overwrites the parameter in place; the previous value is only recoverable through parameter history.

**Usage**

```sh
aws_ssm_put_param <app> <environment> <suffix> <value>
```

**Examples**

```sh
aws_ssm_put_param billing staging env "$(cat .env)"
```

**Requires** `aws`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/aws.sh:223`](../../modules/common/aws.sh#L223)

---

## `aws_ssm_put_param_by_path`

Write a SecureString parameter addressed by its full path.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Overwrites the parameter in place.

**Usage**

```sh
aws_ssm_put_param_by_path </environment/app/suffix> <value>
```

## `aws_ssm_start_session`

Open an SSM Session Manager shell on the first cached instance whose line matches the given substring. Refreshes the cache when missing.

**Usage**

```sh
aws_ssm_start_session <name-fragment> [ssh-user]
```

**Examples**

```sh
aws_ssm_start_session prod-worker
aws_ssm_start_session prod-app ec2-user
```

**Requires** `aws`, `ec2-session`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/aws.sh:447`](../../modules/common/aws.sh#L447)

**See also** `aws_ssm_list_instances`
